_note: 실용 안내문(목적). 학술 유형(주제/주장/요지/제목/빈칸/함축/무관)은 만들지 않음. grammar/vocab 은 밑줄 어구가 본문에 글자 그대로 존재. order/insert 는 구조 재배열, summary/writing 포함.

passage: Dear students, the annual Riverdale Science Fair will be held on July 18 under the theme "Sustainable Future."
Although we announced the fair last month, the number of student registrations remain lower than we expected.
Therefore, we would like to encourage more of you to take part.
You are invited to present a model that relates to environmental conservation or renewable energy.
You will have the opportunity to showcase your work for teachers, peers, and local scientists.
If you are interested, please submit a brief description of your work by June 25.
We look forward to your participation.
Mr. Howard, Science Teacher
grammar.explanation_ko: ② 주어의 핵은 단수명사 the number(~의 수)이므로 동사도 단수 remains 여야 한다. 복수 동사 remain 은 수일치에 어긋나므로 틀리다 → remains 로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①will be held(미래 수동), ③would like to encourage(to부정사), ④선행사 a model(단수)에 맞춘 that relates, ⑤the opportunity to showcase(to부정사 형용사적 용법) 모두 어법상 옳다.

passage: Dear students, the annual Riverdale Science Fair will take place on July 18 under the theme "Sustainable Future."
Although we announced the fair last month, student registration is still higher than we anticipated.
Therefore, we would like to encourage more of you to participate.
You are invited to present a project, an experiment, or a model connected to environmental conservation or renewable energy.
You will have the chance to showcase your work for teachers, peers, and local scientists.
If you are interested, please submit a brief description of your work by June 25.
We look forward to your participation.
Mr. Howard, Science Teacher
vocab.explanation_ko: ② 등록이 예상보다 '낮기(lower)' 때문에 더 많은 참가를 독려하는 흐름이다. higher(더 높은)를 쓰면 독려할 이유가 사라져 글의 논리와 모순되므로 틀리다 → lower 로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①annual(연례의), ③encourage(독려하다), ④conservation(보존), ⑤showcase(선보이다)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: Dear students, the annual Riverdale Science Fair will be held on July 18 with the theme "Sustainable Future."

blocks.A: You are invited to present a project, experiment, or model related to environmental conservation or renewable energy, and you will have the opportunity to showcase your work for teachers, peers, and local scientists.
blocks.B: Although we announced the fair last month, student registration is still lower than we expected, so we would like to encourage more of you to take part.
blocks.C: If you are interested, please submit a brief description of your work by June 25. We look forward to your participation.

order.explanation_ko: 박람회 공지(주어진 글) 뒤에 (B)에서 '등록이 저조하니 참가를 독려'하고, (A)에서 무엇을·왜 발표하는지 구체적으로 안내한 뒤, (C)에서 신청 방법·마감일로 마무리한다. (B)-(A)-(C)가 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 '신청하라/마감일'은 안내 내용(A)을 모두 제시한 뒤에 와야 하므로 첫 순서가 될 수 없다.

insert.insert_sentence: Therefore, we would like to encourage more of you to take part.

passage_marked.text: Dear students, the annual Riverdale Science Fair will be held on July 18 with the theme "Sustainable Future."
Although we announced the fair last month, student registration is still lower than we expected.
You are invited to present a project, experiment, or model related to environmental conservation or renewable energy.
You will have the opportunity to showcase your work for teachers, peers, and local scientists.
If you are interested, please submit a brief description of your work by June 25.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 'Therefore'는 '등록이 저조하다'는 원인(②앞 문장) 뒤에서 '그래서 참가를 독려한다'는 결과를 이끈다. 따라서 등록 저조 언급 직후인 ②에 들어가야 한다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①에 넣으면 인과의 원인(등록 저조)이 아직 제시되지 않아 'Therefore'가 연결되지 않는다.

passage: Dear students, the annual Riverdale Science Fair will be held on July 18 with the theme "Sustainable Future."
Although we announced the fair last month, student registration is still lower than we expected.
Therefore, we would like to encourage more of you to take part.
You are invited to present a project, experiment, or model related to environmental conservation or renewable energy.
You will have the opportunity to showcase your work for teachers, peers, and local scientists.
If you are interested, please submit a brief description of your work by June 25.
We look forward to your participation.
Mr. Howard, Science Teacher
summary.summary_template: Because turnout for the science fair is lower than hoped, the teacher writes to __(A)__ more students to enter eco-themed projects and to __(B)__ a short description by June 25.
summary.explanation_ko: 등록이 저조하므로 더 많은 학생의 참가를 (A)urge(촉구) 하고, 6월 25일까지 간단한 설명을 (B)submit(제출) 하라는 안내이다. ③이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 discourage/forbid(저지·금지)가 아니라 urge, (B)는 withdraw/delay/cancel(철회·지연·취소)가 아니라 submit 이어야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그러므로, 우리는 더 많은 여러분이 참가하도록 독려하고자 합니다.
writing.answer: Therefore, we would like to encourage more of you to take part.
writing.explanation_ko: would like to + 동사원형(encourage), encourage + 목적어(more of you) + to부정사(to take part).

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 여러분은 교사, 또래, 그리고 지역 과학자들에게 여러분의 작품을 선보일 기회를 갖게 될 것입니다.
writing.answer: You will have the opportunity to showcase your work for teachers, peers, and local scientists.
writing.explanation_ko: the opportunity to + 동사원형(showcase)의 형용사적 용법, 등위 명사구 teachers, peers, and local scientists.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 관심이 있다면, 6월 25일까지 여러분의 작품에 대한 간단한 설명을 제출해 주세요.
writing.answer: If you are interested, please submit a brief description of your work by June 25.
writing.explanation_ko: 조건절 If you are interested + 명령문 please submit, 기한 by June 25.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Although we announced the fair last month, student registration is still lower than we expected.
writing.answer: 비록 우리가 지난달에 박람회를 공지했지만, 학생 등록은 우리가 예상했던 것보다 여전히 낮다.
writing.explanation_ko: Although(비록 ~이지만) 양보절, lower than we expected(예상보다 낮은) 비교 구문.
